title: PhySense: Sensor Placement Optimization for Accurate Physics Sensing

predicted_errors.error_location: Theorem 3.5 and Appendix A.2 (Proof of Theorem 3.5, Part 3)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The proof claims that by the arithmetic–geometric mean inequality, (∑ √λ_i)² ≤ 2 ∑ λ_i. This is incorrect for d > 2; the correct bound uses d, not 2. The resulting constants 2/π² and 4/π² are therefore unfounded, and the derived mutual control between L_flow and the A-optimality objective L_A is not valid as stated. This invalidates the theoretical guarantees that the placement objective polynomially controls the A-optimal criterion.
